assumptions.text: Isometric_view:F2 labeled internal_thread is treated as a visual misclassification; authoritative section A-A defines the features as countersunk through holes. No threads will be assumed.

The three mounting holes are interchangeable instances of the same countersunk through-hole specification (TYP.3). They are modeled as one group with instance count coming from the aggregate observations.

Canonical for the hole group is front_view:F4 (a single, non-aggregate observation with explicit location info). Aggregate observations front_view:F3, section_aa:F3, and isometric_view:F2 contribute geometry/GD&T but are not canonical.
Canonical for the part body is front_view:F1 (it carries overall width and height). Section A-A F1 supplies thickness via union.
feature_type for the hole group is overridden from section_aa:F3 to represent the pattern/countersink definition rather than the generic internal_bore from front_view entries.
